notes: A RULING RELABEL. Brandon 2026-10-02 PRE31-C ruling (A): a macro that, in any build configuration or on any runtime path, does not evaluate an argument is unsafe under PRE31-C as written (ADR-0001), including one that evaluates it once or not at all. selection: census of every PRE31-C row on main labeled FP whose recorded reason rests on a zero-, once- or conditionally-evaluating macro being safe (DEBUGF/VERBOSE/DEBUGASSERT, the CURL_TRC_* trace macros, TRACELOG, RADIUS_DEBUG/ERROR, LOG_WOLF_ERROR_VA, WPA_ASSERT, assert/ALWAYS/TESTONLY/REGISTER_TRACE, seL4's assert/SMP_COND_STATEMENT/SMP_STATE_DEFINE, libdlt's DLT_LOG_STRING). Each row was re-derived at the pinned commit: the macro has a configuration or runtime path that does not evaluate the argument, so the verdict turns only on whether an argument at that line has a side effect (a write to an object, a volatile access, or a call to something that does), judged strict (ADR-0015 D5) under the owned-storage ruling. TP where it does; FP restated on a no-side-effect basis where every call in the arguments only reads. Left out of the census as not resting on zero or conditional evaluation: hostap wpa_supplicant/dbus/dbus_new_handlers.c:3324 (not a macro call), the RADIUS_DUMP rows (wpa_hexdump is a function in every build), mbedtls library/entropy_poll.c:60 (BCRYPT_SUCCESS evaluates its argument once in every build). Relaxation tags in provenance: call-side-effect-unproven where the only effect rests on a callee with no definition in the scanned files, a call through a function pointer, inline asm, or a benign-effect C library call (strerror); library-contract trust: contract:stdlib_call_effects where it rests on a C library call the hosted contract judges (strchr, memcmp, strlen). Tag counts: {'call-side-effect-unproven': 9, 'library-contract trust: contract:stdlib_call_effects': 1}. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here. Blind slice: the coordinator's reviewer re-labeled 4 of this batch's rows (random.Random(2023).sample over all 376 first-round keys) from the pinned source before reading the branch label; 0 verdict disagreements. Some sqlite, sel4 and hostap slice rows were not fully blind (the reviewer had printed branch verdicts during the census), as the review discloses.
